answer: Each identity must bind to a distinct carrier-verified SIM: the mobile carrier signs an attestation tying the agent's key to one eSIM subscription, and the network rejects any second identity on the same subscription. Like a vertex where many lines meet but only one path is real, a farm would need a separate paid line per fake. Across the ocean of agents, that recurring cost pushes the sybil horizon beyond profit — fakes cost more than they earn.
